description: Common structure every ENC-2a enc-budget fixture validates against. `kind` names the knob behavior exercised; `env_state` is the raw string value of MEGACOMPACT_NATIVE_ORT_BUDGET_MIB (null when unset); `expected_effective_mib` pins the integer installBudgetMib() must resolve to.
title: ENC-2a native install budget fixture envelope
